title: DecisionState
description: What a consumer did about a Decision. Specified in architecture/decision-state.md. Owned per consumer, keyed by (decision_id, consumer_id).

schema_version.description: Semver of the DecisionState specification this record conforms to.

state_id.description: Globally unique identifier. 'dst_' followed by a 26-character ULID.

consumer_id.description: The consumer whose stream this belongs to. Engines are not consumers.

consumer_version.description: Semver of the consumer build that wrote this record.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Transitions are constrained; see the specification.

status_at.description: When the transition happened. RFC 3339, UTC, Z suffix.

recommendation_id.description: Which recommendation was acted on. Required when status is executed.

action_ref.description: Reference to the Action carried out. Required when status is executed.

reason.description: Why. Required when status is rejected or failed.

metadata.description: Consumer-specific context. Nothing may depend on it for correctness.

created_at.description: When this record was written. RFC 3339, UTC, Z suffix.
